query:
SELECT empresaSlug, 
  COUNT(*) as total_registros,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8 + cat9) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as dias_com_faturamento,
  SUM(cat1 + cat2 + cat3 + cat4 + cat5 + cat6 + cat7 + cat8 + cat9) as faturamento_total
FROM faturamentos 
WHERE tenantId = 1 
AND empresaSlug IN ('barbiero-mascote', 'barbiero-morumbi') 
AND data >= '2026-07-01' AND data <= '2026-07-31'
GROUP BY empresaSlug;
